content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TNMVMD Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Register or login to the National Web Portal at https://nats.education.gov.in. Complete the application form and obtain a unique enrollment number. Under 'Apply against advertised vacancies', search for 'TAMIL NADU MOTOR VEHICLES MAINTENANCE DEPARTMENT'. Click apply and ensure the status shows as 'applied'. Upload the provisional certificate or consolidated mark sheet and ensure percentage of marks is entered in the portal. Apply on or before 29 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: If percentage of marks is not furnished in the NATS portal, candidature will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TNMVMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 29 October 2026. Applications opened on 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in TNMVMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 79 vacancies: 18 Graduate Apprentice - Mechanical Engineering / Automobile Engineering, 61 Technician (Diploma) Apprentice - Mechanical Engineering / Automobile Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for TNMVMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 12300 for Graduate Apprentice - Mechanical Engineering / Automobile Engineering, Rs. 10900 for Technician (Diploma) Apprentice - Mechanical Engineering / Automobile Engineering.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree or Diploma in relevant Engineering/Technology branch. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must be hailing from Tamilnadu. Minimum physical standards as prescribed in Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rule 1992.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have already undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship under Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973. Candidates having one year or more experience are NOT ELIGIBLE to apply.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on the percentage of marks obtained in the basic prescribed qualification. Certificate Verification at TNMVMD, Chennai. Shortlisting of candidates will be done based on the percentage of marks obtained in the basic prescribed qualification.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: One year Apprenticeship training under the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973. No obligation to offer employment upon completion of the Apprenticeship period.
